फणिज्झक: फणिज्झक = फणिज्ज(क) (1) a) MAJORANA HORTENSIS MOENCH. [Intern. Code] = ORIGANUM MAJORANA LINN. (Bpn, p. 510; HB; KB 3, p. 1985-1986; MW; PW; V 8, p. 39); b) Dn, वर्ग 4, 52: = मरुबक = खरपत्र = जम्बीर; Rn, वर्ग 10, 80: = मरुबक = खरपत्र = गन्धपत्र; Ḍa. on Su. Sū. 38, 18: = मरुबक = तीक्ष्णगन्ध; c) = मधुरजम्बीर (see जम्बीर) (Vśs); (2) a) a species of Ocimum (Kav); b) a kind of तुलसी with small leaves (Vśs); c) fragrant तुलसी (Vśs); (3) POGOSTEMON PARVIFLORUS BENTH. (V 6, p. 41); (4) PIPER NIGRUM LINN. (HK: = मरिच, but मरिच is also a name of MAJORANA HORTENSIS MOENCH.); (5) = पलाश (Vśs).
फलाम्ल: फलाम्ल (1) RUMEX VESICARIUS LINN. (KB 3, p. 2114-2115; MW; PW; Vśs: = अम्लवेतस); (2) TAMARINDUS INDICA LINN. (MW; PW); (3) HIBISCUS CANNABINUS LINN. (KB 1, p. 327-329; Nadk. 1, nr. 1218); (4) GARCINIA INDICA CHOISY (KB 1, p. 262-264) = G. PURPUREA ROXB. (KB 1, p. 262-264). See also फलाम्ल, App. 3.
फल: phala (1) Randia spinosa (Thunb.) Poir. = R. dumetorum Lamk. (= madana: HK; Na 1, nr. 265; Dgv, nr. 183); (2) Oroxylum indicum Vent. (HK: śyonāka); (3) Areca catechu Linn. (Nadk. 1, nr. 219: = kramuka).
फलिनी: phalinī (1) = priyaṅgu (Na 1, nr. 201; V. 6, p. 99; Bpn, karpūrādivarga 101; Kai.Nigh., oṣadhivarga 1352); (2) = gandhapriyaṅgu (Indu on A.s. Ci. 2, 51).
